meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商图片文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性文案生成，适用于电商平台的商品营销推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为电商商品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商产品快速撰写吸引眼球的文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for ecommerce products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly write eye-catching copy for ecommerce products

howto.what: 为用户生成或优化电商商品图片文案：先收集产品信息，选定品类模板，按『痛点引入→产品介绍→卖点阐述→情感升华』四段结构撰写标题与正文，并适度添加 emoji，输出 Markdown 格式文案。
howto.when: 当用户提出电商文案创作、文案优化，或要求为电商商品生成营销文案时触发。

say.text: 帮我给一款智能睡眠眼罩写电商文案，卖点是科学遮光。
say.note: 会按四段结构生成带 emoji 的 Markdown 文案。

say.text: 优化这段充电宝文案：标题吸引力不足，突出大容量和快充。
say.note: 会分析原文并改进标题、正文和 emoji。

say.text: 为环保可降解餐具写图片文案，目标用户是注重健康的年轻人。
say.note: 会调用环保生活类模板生成。

howto.what_en: Generates or optimizes e-commerce product image copy: collects product info, picks a category template, writes a title and body using a four-paragraph structure (pain point, product intro, selling points, emotional call to action), adds relevant emoji, and outputs Markdown-formatted copy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests e-commerce copy creation, copy optimization, or marketing copy for e-commerce products.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for a smart sleep mask, highlighting scientific light blocking.
say_en.note: Generates Markdown copy with emoji in the four-paragraph structure.

say_en.text: Optimize this power bank copy; make the title stand out, emphasize capacity and fast charging.
say_en.note: Analyzes and improves title, body, and emoji usage.

say_en.text: Create image copy for a biodegradable tableware set targeting health-conscious young people.
